*   **Overwriting Static Data:** Dynamic updates must not overwrite static parts.
*   **Time Complexity:** The rasterization pass is $O(N)$ where $N$ is the number of fragments generated, which corresponds to the number of potentially occupied leaf nodes.
Deferred execution adds overhead proportional to the number of mutex conflicts.

Deferred execution can add latency if there is high contention.
